rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Kasturi Rangan (India, 1986).
Introduced in India by KSG Sons/KSG's Roses in 1986 as 'Red Recker'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red. Double (17-25 petals), exhibition, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
